strings.en: Roux, good work.
Eh, don't mention it, Captain.
Didn't seem like the time to be lazing around on Jupiter.
Louka? That mobile suit is...
It's a Zeta Gundam, as you can see, Captain. I brought it from Anaheim.
...Apparently, to develop a mass-produced Zeta,
they broke it down into parts once, then put it back together.
Ah, so that's the Re-GZ.
I heard it was sent to the surface for gravity testing...
Another Gundam? I'm glad to get more firepower,
but isn't some, like... awesome super robot gonna show up?
Don't be greedy, Koji. We've got Grendizer and Zambot 3, don't we?
Another Gundam... I'd like two or three more super robots.
It can't be helped. Most of them are on the surface.
Besides, we have Daisuke, and the Jins' Zambot 3, don't we?
That's right. We don't need anyone else!
But the more strength we have, the better, don't you think?
True... It'd help if those allies who suddenly appear always came...
Oh yeah! Captain Bright, who are those people?
Honestly, we'd have been in trouble without them, but...
...I don't know. Only that he's from another star system... an alien.
He sure wasn't wearing a spacesuit... Can anything live without oxygen?
I don't care what his background is.
Brother, you really like him, don't you?
Does he come up with those sayings on the spot, I wonder?
Anyway, Roux, thanks for coming.
...Now, next we need to hear from the Zambot team.
Roux, good work!
You look well too. What's up?
Heh, I'm just curious about Judau.
You made it out, so what's he doing?
The Double Zeta.
The Double Zeta!?
Wasn't that dismantled after the last war ended?
Anaheim. They apparently took in the whole thing, parts and all.
Huh? I got my mobile suit from there too...
You guys too!?
That's right. Judau's still over there waiting on the Double Zeta, though.
Then... you're saying this enemy, the Gaizok, has no goal?
That's what Gramps said.
It's not that they don't have a goal, they just wanna kill living things.
He said our ancestors got wiped out by 'em...
Your ancestors? What does that mean?
Says they were aliens from a planet called Bial.
The Bialians were wiped out by the Gaizok, and survivors came to Earth.
When we were suddenly told that, we couldn't believe it, but...
the Gaizok really do exist.
These kids are aliens? ...Sounds like some kind of joke.
But the Umon siblings are from Fleed, Captain Burning.
They look human, any way you slice it.
It's not like they've got pointy ears or three eyes or anything.
Who cares what we are?
We haven't finished off the Gaizok yet. There's plenty to do!
Jin has a point.
...By the way, is there really no way to find the Cyber Beast Force?
...Hmm, they rammed into the Gaizok battleship,
and both got blown away. We went after the Gaizok,
so... the Cyber Beast Force went the other way.
Hmm... Well, Captain, I guess we'll have to be satisfied
that we at least joined up with the Mazinger team.
That mysterious bony enemy that showed up in the ring of meteors...
That's got nothing to do with the Gaizok or anything, right?
(Seems nobody else noticed that voice... Was I just hearing things?)
Solve one problem, and another pops up... It never gets easier...
Captain, why not contact Commander Hazuki of the Gandor Team for now?
There's the matter of the Mazinger and Zambot teams, too.
Right. Very well, open a channel!
Our forces are... really coming together.
That's right. Now that we're here, we'll make it easy on you, Daisuke.
You were crying "help me~" back at that abandoned colony,
so you're in no position to brag, Koji.
Don't be like that, Sayaka.
Well, just bein' safe is a lucky break.
Kojiii!
Oh, Maria, how've you been?
Glad you look well too. Is everything all right on the surface?
Yeah, Tetsuya's there. I wish I could've fought alongside him, though.
But I'm really glad. Having you here is reassuring.
Leave it all to us! ...That said, about the Cyber Beast Force...
Yeah... But if things had gone wrong, the HLV might have been
shot down... It's hard to say.
...You don't know where they are?
We had our hands full just stabilizing the HLV.
We couldn't check on them at all.
Well, they ain't the type to kick the bucket that easy.
Yeah. I'd have liked to bring Koji too... but it's dicey on the surface.
We didn't exactly join up without trouble either, Tetsuya.
Well, just bein' safe is a lucky break.
You were surrounded by a weird bunch at that colony.
I was really worried.
Well, that bunch... was nothing.
Big talk! Oh, right, how's Koji doing?
He's fine, Maria. We wanted to fight together, but...
Koji's doing his own job down there.
Sayaka's with him too, so worryin' is a waste.
But I'm really glad. Having you here is reassuring.
By rights, the Cyber Beast Force should have been here with us too...
No use talking about it. If they hadn't jumped out there,
the Gaizok might've taken us all out at once...
...You don't know where they are?
No. ...Honestly, they don't think ahead at all.
Well, they ain't the type to kick the bucket that easy.
So... either way, all we can do is wait for word.
Yes. The Cyber Beast Force... I'd like to meet them soon.
Whaaat! For real!? THE Domon Kasshu is over there?
Yeah. He's apparently chasing the Ultimate Gundam...
the Gundam now called the Devil Gundam.
Hey, could you get me his autograph? Actually, let me talk to him.
If I get the chance. ...Anyway, what did you want to talk about?
Oops! That's not what I called about today...
Say, Kyosuke, those bone-like things, and the plant-like ones...
haven't they shown up down there?
They're appearing in space too...
You too, huh... Somehow I'm the only one who hears their voices~
You too... Excellen?
So you hear them too, Kyosuke! Phew, I'm not the only one...
Why can only we hear them?
The only thing we have in common is that one thing, so...
Yeah, true... but I don't see why.
Right... and that girl seemed to know you, Kyosuke...
Girl? What are you talking about?
A red machine that showed up with the bone things...
From the voice, she sounded like a little girl...
She hasn't gone your way?
No. The bone things appeared, but I haven't seen any red machine...
I see... She said, "I'm going to see Kyosuke, I am."
Me? What does that mean?
I don't get it... What do we do, Kyosuke?
I haven't told anyone in Londo Bell yet...
Better keep quiet for now... It'd only cause needless confusion.
Right. So that's that. We're sortieing soon, so I'm hanging up.
Yeah.
If you get lonely, call me anytime. I'll be waiting.
(Kyosuke and me... What connection could we have to that enemy...?)
Inside Mars's thermosphere. Phase transition engine output dropping~
What's that?
A mass of nanomachines.
Nano?
Nanomachines... tiny self-replicating machines...
They used nanomachines to bring Mars's atmosphere closer to Earth's.
Hmm...
Indeed. Even now they keep the atmosphere stable like that,
and block harmful UV rays. Even with no one left to benefit...
Passing first nanomachine layer.
Is it okay for that stuff to get inside the Nadesico?
Don't worry. Everyone on Mars lived breathing that air,
so it's basically harmless.
It comes out when you go to the bathroom. Oops, shouldn't say that.
Ah yes, you were born on Mars too, Captain.
...I see...
Gravity Blast, stand by.
Fine, but... you should've used it in space while you were at it.
There should be a second wave below. We'll strike before we're surrounded.
Turn the bow toward the enemy, please.
Enemies eliminated. No Jovian Lizard readings within 30 km.
First... we'll head for the research facility at Olympus Mons.
